description: Offline validation of a plan containing two groups and one job action. This describes the plan without executing it.
notes: executes_jobs describes what the plan would do if attached to a deployment; validation itself never executes jobs. valid covers intrinsic checks, not target readiness or permissions. --source adds local reference/type checks; references missing from it are warnings unless --strict is supplied. Findings are capped at 100 errors and 100 warnings.
